summary: SKK Holdings Ltd filed a 6-K reporting shareholder approval of an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire substantially all drone-based technology assets of Rantizo, Inc. for $759,047 in cash and ~$258.8 million in newly issued Class A ordinary shares (total ~$259.6 million). Additional shares valued at $22 million will be issued to management and as escrow consideration. Class B shareholders (100 votes per share) overwhelmingly approved. The deal also includes a name change to Rantizo. The filing does not specify a premium, advisor, or expected close date; watch for regulatory approvals and share issuance mechanics.
